verdict.rationale: Morph is an API service, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no such opt-out control. The only privacy-related item is a community quote of tiered training-data terms (free tier may be trained on, enterprise tier not). That is an adjacent data-use policy tied to plan level, not a user-facing telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.
